parameters.command: =TAX=$(cat /image-eval-radar/dimensions.md); PROMPT=$(cat /image-eval-radar/prompts/classify.txt); printf '%s' "{{ $json.payload }}" | base64 -d > /tmp/eval-batch.json; { printf '%s\n' "$PROMPT"; cat /tmp/eval-batch.json; } | /usr/local/bin/claude -p --model claude-haiku-4-5 --append-system-prompt "$TAX"
